**VIDEO 1.** [Build an LLM from Scratch 1: Set up your code environment](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yAcWnfsZhzo)

Links to the book: 

[Amazon](https://amzn.to/4fqvn0D)

[Manning](https://mng.bz/M96o)

Link to Sebastian Raschka's Github respository: 

[**Sebastian Raschka's GitHub Repository**](https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch.git)
<br>
This is a supplementary video explaining how to set up a Python environment using uv. 

In particular, we are using `uv pip`, which is explained in this document: [uv pip explanation](https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch.git)

Alternatively, the native `uv add` syntax (mentioned but not explicitly covered in this video) is described here.  
[Native uv Python and package management](https://github.com/rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch/blob/main/setup/01_optional-python-setup-preferences/native-uv.md)
